GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.33 (13 Nov 46) GC
(SCAPIN-1336)
APO 500
13 November 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Closing of Reception Center at Senzaki.
1. Reference is made to:
a. Memorandum from Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers file AG 370.05 (7 May 46)GC, (SCAPIN 927), dated 7 May 1946, subject, "Repatriation," as amended.
b. Memorandum from Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers file AG 014.33 (9 Aug 46)GC, (SCAPIN 1116) dated 9 August 1946, subject, "Suspension of Repatriation Through the Senzaki Reception Center."
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will take necessary steps to initiate closing the repatriation reception center at Senzaki immediately and to insure completion thereof prior to 15 December 1946.
3. A report will be made to Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers by 20 December 1946 of compliance with provisions of this memorandum.
4. The provisions of references paragraph 1 above are amended accordingly.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
